title: Chain-of-Evidence literature workflow
description: Adds explicit PaperCard, RejectedPaper, ClaimCard, GapCard, IdeaCard, and EvidenceEdge schemas; introduces strict phase gates before map, gap, and idea generation; and requires semantic literature graph edges for evidence-backed synthesis.
changes: Add Chain-of-Evidence object schemas for papers, rejected candidates, claims, gaps, ideas, and graph edges.
Require claim_cards.jsonl and evidence_edges.jsonl before gap mapping.
Require explicit user approval before moving from gap map to idea bank.
Define semantic relation types for literature graph edges, including cites, extends, same_task, same_benchmark, compares_with, gap_supports, and gap_counterexample.
Strengthen phase gates so weak retrieval evidence stops the workflow instead of producing fabricated maps, gaps, or ideas.

rollback.notes: Restore the evidence-first workflow without explicit Chain-of-Evidence object schemas and graph-edge contracts.
